podcast.body: A cassette recording of a particularly brutal performance at Michigan Palace in 1974, where Iggy Pop demanded a Detroit gang beat him on stage and the audience threw beer bottles. This album, released years later, was formerly a highly respected bootleg and is known for its raw and dangerous quality, with breaking beer bottles audible on the recording. "Years later a cassette recording of that performance would be released on an album called Metallic KO."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Iggy Pop

podcast.body: This album contains a live recording of the infamous 1974 gig in Wayne, Michigan, where the band confronted a biker gang. Listeners can hear the sound of beer bottles shattering on stage during the performance. "That show with the bikers was recorded and eventually released as a set called Metallic TKO."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Most Dangerous Artists in Rock
